description: This file defines the 'Shortcuts' class for managing shortcut items in the Notesnook project, including methods for adding, resolving, and removing shortcuts, and handling related data types.

classes.name: Shortcuts
classes.description: A class managing shortcut items, allowing addition, resolution, and deletion of shortcuts, with support for different item types like notebooks and tags.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new shortcut, merging with existing if necessary, with validation.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Resolves shortcut IDs to actual Notebook or Tag objects, filtered by type.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a shortcut exists by ID.
